connection.title: Internet connection status
connection.intro: Your connection status to the internet is continuously updated and shown in color as follows:
connection.goodExplanation: All functions of the app are available without restriction. You can load content, transfer data and interact with other users without any problems.
connection.slowExplanation: Some functions of the app may be restricted. Loading content may take longer, and there may be delays in data transfer.
connection.offlineExplanation: You are currently offline. Some functions of the app are not available, and you cannot load or transfer new data. Please check your internet connection.
